parsed.reply: «La balsa» is moderately common, though mostly when you are talking about river crossings, emergency floats, or specific water sports. In everyday Spanish, you will hear it used for rafts or pontoon-style boats, and metaphorically in some regions to describe a very calm body of water («es una balsa de aceite»).
followUps: Give me an example of the metaphor
How is it different from bote?
